نختلف (form VIII)
# نَخْتَلِفُ (naḵtalifu) /nax.ta.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
# نَخْتَلِفَ (naḵtalifa) /nax.ta.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
# نَخْتَلِفْ (naḵtalif) /nax.ta.lif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
